        'West,Gadget,0.50,6,other\r\n',
        encoding="utf-8",
        newline="",
    )
    original = source.read_bytes()

    result = run(source)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    rows = json.loads(result.stdout)
    assert rows[0]["item"] == "Widget, large"
    assert rows[0]["note"] == "line one\nline two"
    assert [row["region"] for row in rows] == ["West", "East", "West"]

    result = run(source, "--where", "region=West", "--where", "item=Gadget")
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    assert json.loads(result.stdout) == [{
        "region": "West", "item": "Gadget", "amount": "0.50",
        "units": "6", "note": "other"
    }]

    result = run(source, "--group-by", "region", "--sum", "amount", "--avg", "units")
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    assert json.loads(result.stdout) == [
        {"region": "East", "sum_amount": "2.3", "avg_units": "4"},
        {"region": "West", "sum_amount": "1.7", "avg_units": "4"},
    ]

    result = run(source, "--group-by", "region", "--sum", "amount", "--output", "csv")
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    assert list(csv.reader(result.stdout.splitlines())) == [
        ["region", "sum_amount"], ["East", "2.3"], ["West", "1.7"]
    ]

    failures = []
    failures.append(run(source, "--where", "missing=x"))
    failures.append(run(source, "--where", "broken"))
    failures.append(run(source, "--sum", "amount"))

    bad_width = tmp / "bad-width.csv"
    bad_width.write_text("a,b\n1\n", encoding="utf-8")
    failures.append(run(bad_width))

    duplicate = tmp / "duplicate.csv"
    duplicate.write_text("a,a\n1,2\n", encoding="utf-8")
    failures.append(run(duplicate))

    bad_number = tmp / "bad-number.csv"
    bad_number.write_text("g,n\nx,nope\n", encoding="utf-8")
    failures.append(run(bad_number, "--group-by", "g", "--sum", "n"))

    blank_number = tmp / "blank-number.csv"
    blank_number.write_text("g,n\nx,\n", encoding="utf-8")
    failures.append(run(blank_number, "--group-by", "g", "--avg", "n"))

    malformed = tmp / "malformed.csv"
    malformed.write_text('a,b\n"unterminated,2\n', encoding="utf-8")
    failures.append(run(malformed))

    assert all(r.returncode != 0 and r.stderr.strip() for r in failures), [
        (r.returncode, r.stderr) for r in failures
    ]
    assert "row 2" in failures[-3].stderr and "'n'" in failures[-3].stderr
    assert source.read_bytes() == original
